about.description: OKTA is a single-stock perpetual listed on OKX, tracking Okta, Inc., margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 10× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
